12182:	def sf_drift(slow, fast, tau, evolve, recurse, bridge):	fs, ss = slow.shape[0], slow.shape[1]	s1, s2 = slow[:,fs], slow[:,ss]	d = tau * fs / (fs + ss)	slow_new = evolve(s1, tau) + evolve(s2, tau) * d	r = 1.0 / fast.norm()	tau_r = tau * r	fast_new = recurse(fast, tau_r, evolve, bridge)	r_evolve = 1.0 / evolve(slow_new, tau)	r_recurse = r / recurse(fast_new, tau_r, evolve, bridge)	r_bridge = r_evolve / r_recurse	slow_new = bridge(slow_new, tau, r_recurse, r_bridge)	return slow_new, fast_new
